name: NGC 1903 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 1903, a young star cluster in the Large Magellanic Cloud, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc1903-hubble
story: A young cluster of stars in the Large Magellanic Cloud, home to a red giant star wrapped in its own dust. Around it lies an older population of field stars.

claims.text: NGC 1903 is a young star cluster in the Large Magellanic Cloud
NGC 1903 contains a dust-enshrouded, oxygen-rich red giant (NGC 1903-IR3) that is a cluster member
Redder stars near NGC 1903 belong to an intermediate-age field population
